ai.title: Choose your coach's intelligence
ai.subtitle: The easiest way is to use the AI already built into your phone: free, private, no account.

providers.anthropic: Claude models. Strong reasoning, with a focus on safety.
providers.openai: GPT models, the same ones behind ChatGPT.
providers.gemini: Google's Gemini models, with a free tier to get started.

anthropic.1: Open the Anthropic Console and sign in or create an account.
anthropic.2: Under Billing, add a payment method or prepaid credit.
anthropic.3: Go to API Keys and tap "Create Key"; give it a name such as AlbA.
anthropic.4: Tap "Copy" next to the key and close the page: the key will be filled in and verified automatically.

openai.1: Open the OpenAI platform and sign in or create an account.
openai.2: Under Billing, add credit: a ChatGPT subscription does not cover the API.
openai.3: Go to API keys and tap "Create new secret key".
openai.4: Tap "Copy" next to the key and close the page: the key will be filled in and verified automatically.

gemini.1: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account.
gemini.2: Tap "Create API key" and choose or create a project.
gemini.3: Tap "Copy" next to the key and close the page: the key will be filled in and verified automatically.

ai.billingNote: AI usage is billed by the provider to your account, based on consumption. Your key stays on this phone: we never receive or see it.
ai.keyHint: It is stored in your phone's secure keychain.
ai.keySavedHint: A key is already saved. Paste a new one only if you want to replace it.

body.title: Body

macroInfo.protein: Protein: {{grams}} g of a {{target}} g target, that is {{perKg}} g per kg of body weight. The bar fills toward the target and turns green when you reach it.
macroInfo.proteinNoTarget: Protein: {{grams}} g. Add your weight to your profile to get a daily target.

proteinBasis.efsa: This is the EFSA requirement for an adult.
proteinBasis.older: From 65, a little more helps keep muscle and strength.
proteinBasis.active: You move a lot: for active people 1.2 to 2 g per kg is recommended.
proteinBasis.loseWeight: While losing weight you need more to keep your muscle.
proteinBasis.muscle: To build muscle: above 1.6 g per kg the benefits stop growing.

macroInfo.freeSugar: For added sugars (sweets, soft drinks, honey, juices) the WHO recommends staying below {{free}} g a day.
macroInfo.saturated: Of this, saturated fat (butter, cheese, fatty meat) is {{sat}} g: the WHO recommends staying below {{max}} g, less than 10% of calories. Above it the text turns red.

carbsBasis.efsa: Carbs: {{grams}} g, about {{pct}}% of today's calories. Without a specific diet the EFSA range applies, 45–60% of calories ({{min}}–{{max}} g with your target): the bar fills toward the top.
carbsBasis.lowCarb: Carbs: {{grams}} g. With the diet you chose ({{diet}}) you usually stay between {{min}} and {{max}} g a day, from vegetables, some fruit and legumes: the bar fills toward {{max}} g.
carbsBasis.keto: Net carbs (carbs minus fiber): {{grams}} g. With {{diet}} you stay between 20 and {{max}} g a day to reach and keep ketosis: the bar fills toward {{max}} g and turns red above it. Leafy greens count little because they are rich in fiber.
carbsBasis.carnivore: Net carbs: {{grams}} g. With {{diet}} carbs are almost absent: the bar fills toward {{max}} g and turns red above it.

sugarBasis.eu: Sugars (natural and added, already included in carbs): {{sugar}} g of an indicative maximum of {{max}} g a day, the EU reference intake. The bar turns red above the limit.
sugarBasis.who5: Sugars: {{sugar}} g. With {{diet}} sugar should be kept to a minimum, so I use the WHO's stricter limit, 5% of calories: {{max}} g a day. The bar turns red above it.

fatBasis.efsa: Fat: {{grams}} g, about {{pct}}% of today's calories. Without a specific diet EFSA recommends 20–35% of calories: the bar fills toward the top, {{max}} g with your target.
fatBasis.mediterranean: Fat: {{grams}} g, about {{pct}}% of today's calories. The Mediterranean diet includes more, mostly extra-virgin olive oil and nuts: up to about 40% of calories, {{max}} g with your target.
fatBasis.fuel: Fat: {{grams}} g, about {{pct}}% of today's calories. With {{diet}} fat is the main source of energy and is eaten to satiety, not as a goal: there is no cap. The bar shows about {{max}} g, the energy left after protein and carbs.

macroInfo.saturatedLowCarb: With {{diet}} it is easy to go over: prefer extra-virgin olive oil, avocado, olives, fatty fish and nuts, and keep an eye on LDL cholesterol in your labs.
